editDialog.title: Edit Location
editDialog.description: Update this location's details and working hours.

archiveDialog.description: Archived locations are hidden from active lists. You can still view this location, but its screens will no longer count toward usage.

deleteDialog.description: This permanently deletes the location. This action cannot be undone.

list.description: Override all schedules on targeted screens. Use with care.
